signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Elite pass rushers are a mix of strength, speed, and tenacity. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one pass blocks.
Defenders with this ability are granted a free pass rush move once per play after spending a pass rush point
Pass rushers with this ability must spend double the pass rush points to perform a move but are granted dominant wins
Defenders with this ability will win pass blocks when they correctly use the Guess Play adjustment to predict a pass. Incorrect guesses will result in a loss.
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Effective D-Line captains aren't just examples to follow, they are motivators. When they enter the zone, all opposing blockers have their resistance bars wiped out.
Pass rushers with this ability must spend double the pass rush points to perform a move but are granted dominant wins
Defenders with this ability are granted a free pass rush move once per play after spending a pass rush point
Defenders with this ability will grant a bonus pass rush point to all defensive linemen on any 3rd or 4th down
Defenders with this ability use faster; more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the interior of the defensive line.
Blockers with this ability have an increased number of blocker resistance points
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move while pass blocking.
Players with this ability can detect user-controlled defenders before the snap; as well as 3rd and 4th down blitzers. Can be bluffed.

Pass rushers with this ability are granted an additional maximum pass rush move point

Not all receivers need fancy footwork. When they enter the zone, they have increased success chance on stiff arm and truck attempts following the catch.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke animations.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 10-20 yards from the LoS, inside the numbers
Ballcarriers with this ability retain more of their forward momentum during tackles while travelling at high speeds.

signatureAbility.signatureActivationDescription: Make consecutive passes for 5+ yards in air
signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Accurate passers know that ball placement is the difference between a touchdown and a turnover. When they enter the zone, all passes are thrown with perfect accuracy.
Passers with this ability receive better pass blocking from their offensive linemen.
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all deep throws while their feet are set (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have faster passing speed and release the ball quicker.
Passers with this ability are immune to throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while their feet are set in the pocket
Passers with this ability have increased throw power on bullet precision passes (except on high/low throws).
